drafts.subject: Re: Speaking invitation - AgentConf 2026 (Oct 14-15, Berlin)
drafts.message:
Dear Elena,

Thank you so much for the invitation to speak at AgentConf 2026. We're honored to be considered, and we'd be happy to accept. One of our team members will deliver the 30-minute talk on Jac and the walker model.

We'll follow up shortly with the confirmed speaker's name and details. Thanks also for covering travel and accommodation — we really appreciate it.

Looking forward to being part of AgentConf 2026!

Best regards,
Jaseci Impact Team
